en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European village nestled among rolling hills and scattered trees. The village features numerous half-timbered houses and a prominent church with a tall steeple situated on higher ground. The text 'Gruss aus Zehren.' is written in red script at the bottom, and on the left margin is '128. Brück & Sohn, Meißen.'
